checks_without_found_defects: Both compile APIs preserve the prior success predicate across 48 completed-process combinations: zero/nonzero/negative return, timeout flag, parsed Lean error and missing/regular artifact. Metadata cannot make a rejected compile pass.

Exact requested and launcher argv, source/setup hashes, cwd, launcher returncode and actual timeout flag are retained independently; requested Lean heap and sandbox AS/CPU/file/core/wall limits match actual arguments to sandbox.run/_limits.
Full arbitrary-byte stdout/stderr including invalid UTF8, NUL and a panic preceding the legacy stderr tail survive losslessly with exact byte count, SHA256 and base64 roundtrip.
Reported memory-panic text coexists with parsed Lean errors; no peak RSS, host OOM cause, termination signal, specific failed memory boundary or proof-success-with-more-memory is inferred.

Completed process records survive existing stage/artifact infrastructure errors and later compiler-inventory/kernel/audit failures without changing existing diagnostic codes/severity; pre-invocation failures cannot inherit a prior record.
CompileResult and Build default fields keep old positional/synthetic consumers compatible; missing telemetry is explicitly unavailable; preview copies protect later mutation.

Actual hash-bound raw EvidenceStore results retain successful A/B module inventories, while DETERMINISTIC observations, semantic certificate descriptors and fresh clean-build comparison output fields remain unaffected by volatile telemetry.
Agent success check files and advisory CLI inventory file/path/hash retention pass; advisory data does not become a new proof predicate.

scope_and_provenance.sources: Exact immutable author checkpoint copied into isolated generic runtime; consulted workingtree modules and telemetry AST regions also captured. The runtime cannot observe concurrent readable edits.

scope_and_provenance.closed_observation_boundary: The new record is observational. Full consumed telemetry is frozen evidence; this audit does not recommend treating it as fresh A/B semantic output or stripping it recursively.
